TASKS.summary: Lists background maintenance tasks for an index.
TASKS.complexity: O(N) where N is the number of shards the bucket uses.

reply_schema.description: The maintenance tasks of the index, keyed by task id.

additionalProperties.description: One task. A BUILD task also reports its cursor and its range.

kind.description: One of BOUNDARY, BUILD, DROP or ANALYZE.

cursor.description: How far the build has moved. BUILD tasks only.

lower.description: The start of the range the build covers. BUILD tasks only.

upper.description: The end of the range the build covers. BUILD tasks only.

status.description: One of WAITING, RUNNING, COMPLETED, FAILED or STOPPED.

error.description: The last error of the task. Empty when the task has not failed.

arguments.name: bucket
arguments.summary: The name of the bucket that owns the index.

arguments.name: index
arguments.summary: The name of the index to report the tasks of.
